text.心地よさを感じるデザイン: Design you feel at ease in
text.都心のマンションでありながらも、家にいる時はゆったりとした時を過ごしてほしい。: Even in a city apartment, the hours spent at home should be unhurried ones.
text.私共では、窓からの景色を取り込んだり、光や風の流れを意識してプランニングを行いな: We plan around the view through the window and the movement of light and air, and we avoid things that tire the body — stone-paved floors among them. The aim is design that the body itself registers as comfortable.
text.個別の感性を包み込む唯一無二のデザイン。: Design made around one person’s way of seeing, and no one else’s.
text.流行やトレンドを追ったデザインや、スタイルを強制するようなデザインではなく、お客: We do not chase fashions, and we do not impose a style. We design a home to be lived in alongside the hours and the things that matter to the people in it.
text.永く愛されるデザイン: Design that is loved for a long time
text.年月と共に味わい深くなり、永く愛すことのできるデザイン。: Design that gains character with the years, and can be loved for a long time.
text.新しく開発された自然素材ではなく、安全性・信頼性が確立されていて、何年先でも供給: Rather than newly developed natural materials, we use building materials whose safety and reliability are settled and which will still be supplied years from now, so that a repair is always possible. Looked after properly, they take on a character of their own.
text.やさしさをカタチにするデザイン: Design that gives form to kindness
text.ゲストをお迎えする玄関に「しつらい」を工夫できるスペースを設けたり、日々のリビン: A place at the entrance where something can be set out for a guest; a living room that lets the season in.
text.日本人が大切にしてきた、ゲストや共に住むパートナーへの「心づかい」。そんな「やさ: The consideration Japan has long shown a guest, and the person one lives with — it is the sense of beauty that comes from that kindness that we design.
